claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Desoximetasone is a potent topical glucocorticoid that at 2.5 uM is expected to produce little or no direct cytotoxicity in a 5-day pooled viability screen, since its pharmacological action is anti-inflammatory glucocorticoid receptor agonism rather than antiproliferative killing.
